posts.title: NVidia Driver and CUDA on Debian
posts.description: Install NVidia driver to play games. Install CUDA to run local AI and crack passwords. In just 4 commands. Debian Wiki now recommends the approach used here: install NVidia drivers from NVidia. Updated for Debian 13-Trixie. posts.title: Tricks for NVidia and CUDA on Debian
posts.description: Moved some NVidia and CUDA tricks here, to keep the install instructions to basics. You need to install the drivers first. See NVidia Driver and CUDA on Debian . Coding with CUDA # ↑ You just installed CUDA. 'sudo apt-get install cuda-toolkit'. If you actually want to code with it, you might need additional packages. $ sudo apt-get install g++ freeglut3-dev build-essential libx11-dev libxmu-dev li
